seo.title: About the Practice
seo.description: Learn about ProDenta, a friendly private dental practice in Battersea with a patient-centred approach and a focus on prevention.

heading: Dentistry that is friendly and stress free
intro: Our philosophy is simple: keep dentistry as friendly and stress free as possible, and keep you comfortable while we achieve the best possible result.
story: We believe strongly in the old adage that prevention is better than cure. Good oral hygiene and the right brushing technique make an enormous difference, so we take a long-term approach to your care.
When you need more than routine care, we provide comprehensive treatment and specialist referral within the practice. Children are very welcome, and we enjoy helping them build good habits early.
We use high-quality dental materials and take time to help you understand your current dental health and how to avoid future problems.

values.title: Patient-centred care
values.text: We focus on keeping you comfortable while achieving the best possible results for your oral health.

values.title: Clear communication
values.text: You will always be fully informed about your options, every step of the way.

values.title: A family-friendly welcome
values.text: Children and adults alike are looked after in a cheerful, relaxed environment.

values.title: Trust
values.text: We want you to feel confident coming back for regular care and maintenance.
